title: Build a Binary Search Tree in Python
description: Greenfield Python task: implement a BST class with insert, search, inorder traversal, minimum, maximum, and height operations.

injections.content:
from src.bst import BST


def test_insert_and_search():
    t = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
        t.insert(v)
    assert t.search(3) is True
    assert t.search(6) is False


def test_inorder():
    t = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
        t.insert(v)
    assert t.inorder() == [1, 3, 4, 5, 7]


def test_min_max():
    t = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
        t.insert(v)
    assert t.minimum() == 1
    assert t.maximum() == 7


def test_height():
    t = BST()
    assert t.height() == 0
    t.insert(5)
    assert t.height() == 1
    t.insert(3)
    t.insert(7)
    assert t.height() == 2


def test_empty():
    t = BST()
    assert t.search(1) is False
    assert t.inorder() == []

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the BST class in src/bst.py.

Required methods:
- insert(val) — insert value into the BST (ignore duplicates)
- search(val) -> bool — return True if val exists
- inorder() -> list — return sorted list of all values (left-root-right)
- minimum() -> int | None — return smallest value
- maximum() -> int | None — return largest value
- height() -> int — return tree height (0 for empty tree, 1 for root only)

All 5 tests in tests/test_bst.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: insert uses recursive or iterative BST insertion
search walks left/right based on comparison
inorder returns values in sorted ascending order
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.bst import BST" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
